fato_historico: 1014: Byzantine–Bulgarian wars: Battle of Kleidion: Byzantine emperor Basil II inflicts a decisive defeat on the Bulgarian army, and his subsequent treatment of 15,000 prisoners reportedly causes Tsar Samuil of Bulgaria to die of a heart attack less than three months later, on October 6.
energia_do_dia: The cosmos hums with a powerful energy of transformation. Perhaps it is time to turn a page with grace, focusing on your personal victory and the resilient strength glowing deep within your adventurous Sagittarius spirit.
frase_do_dia: True strength is found in how we rise after the storm passes.

conselho: Consider letting go of heavy memories to invite new luck into your life.
